items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: And a lot of the musicians I met and sang, a lot of boys from Alexander, John Duncan, Zeb, and Tav Krohn, a lot of the fellas around there.

ctx.x: This is Bill Russover interviewing Charles Hamilton over at 732 St. Peter Street. And the date is March the 21st, 1965. Can you give your full name if you have a middle name?
Yeah, my full name is Charles Joseph Hamilton.

Texas, that was our territory. We done good. Well, I had a chance to meet a lot of guys and get a lot of experience in music, along in that line. And a lot of the musicians I met and sang, a lot of boys from Alexander, John Duncan, Zeb, and Tav Krohn, a lot of the fellas around there. And there was a bunch of fellas there now from Elorade around there, Leonard Parker, and there was a fine little excellent banjo player around there, and we called him Baby Buster.
